bearer_exemption_conditions: Authorization header specifies case-insensitive Bearer scheme (RFC 7235)

csrf_specifications.cookie_validation_mechanism: Double-submit cookie matching: X-CSRF-Token header matches clara_csrf_token cookie via secrets.compare_digest

interface_assumptions: Cookie sessions authenticate via clara_access_token or clara_refresh_token HttpOnly cookies.
Mutating requests using session cookies must supply a matching readable clara_csrf_token cookie and X-CSRF-Token header.
Bearer token authentication is inherently immune to browser cross-site request forgery because browsers never auto-attach Authorization headers across origins.
A Bearer token exempts a request from CSRF validation only if it is cryptographically valid and unrevoked; malformed or revoked Bearer headers fail closed rather than falling back to cookie session.
Auth error responses and CSRF rejections are constant-time and emit zero PII/PHI (static detail strings).
